description: This car interior cleaner revitalizes fabric surfaces with Foaming Citrus Fabric Clean Carpet & Upholstery Cleaner (CWS20316). Whether you’re refreshing your car’s interior, tackling high-traffic household areas, or cleaning office seating, Foaming Citrus Fabric Clean delivers the power and convenience to restore fabrics quickly and effectively. It’s great for car owners and car enthusiasts to use during their routine vehicle maintenance, deep cleaning and detailing of car interiors.
